description: Implementation of the NRPPPA (NR Positioning Protocol for Public and Private Applications) handling logic, including message parsing, timer management, and procedure invocation for 3GPP-compliant network elements.

classes.name: nrppa_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing NRPPPA protocol handling, including message processing, timer management, and procedure scheduling.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes UE context if it exists.

methods.name: initialize_meas_report_timer
methods.description: Initializes and starts measurement report timer for a UE.

methods.name: handle_e_cid_meas_result
methods.description: Constructs and sends an E-CID measurement report message.

methods.name: on_meas_report_timer_expired
methods.description: Handles expiration of measurement report timer, triggers measurement result collection.

methods.name: handle_new_nrppa_pdu
methods.description: Parses and processes incoming NRPPa PDU messages.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Dispatches handling based on the type of initiating message.

methods.name: handle_e_cid_meas_initiation_request
methods.description: Handles E-CID measurement initiation requests, creating UE context if needed.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Handles successful outcome messages (not fully implemented).

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Handles unsuccessful outcome messages (not fully implemented).
